panels.title: Checkout attempts
panels.description: Every checkout call, including replays and rejections. Accepted means the order was saved as PENDING_INVENTORY. It does not mean the saga has confirmed the order.

panels.title: Saga outcomes
panels.description: Orders that reached CONFIRMED, PAYMENT_FAILED, CANCELLED, or FAILED. Intermediate states are in the active gauge, not here.

panels.title: Active sagas
panels.description: Orders whose saga is not finished. A number that grows while Kafka lag grows means commands are not being applied.

panels.title: Payment results
panels.description: Payment rows that changed to succeeded, failed, cancelled, or refunded. A replay of the same result does not increment this.
